# Ace Fishing Guide project notes

- Keep tide, weather, legal and access data honest: never invent live values, permission, catch rates, prices or business records.
- Mark approximate and unverified location content clearly; private coordinates must never be exposed publicly.
- Use the existing Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Leaflet and Lucide patterns.
- Keep user-owned data behind server-side authorization and Supabase RLS when persistence is implemented.
- Run `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run build` before considering a change complete.
